[[File:Soundtrack.jpg|right|200px]]
'''A Soundtrack for the Wheel of Time''' is a soundtrack created by [[Wikipedia:Robert Berry|Robert Berry]] to accompany the [[The Wheel of Time|books]], resulting in nearly an hour of songs. Most of the songs are instrumental, and many bear a heavy [[Wikipedia:Celtic|Celtic]] sound due to the background of some of the musicians.

The soundtrack was released on July 10, 2001, and was ultimately intended to be listened to while reading the novels.
